description: Rename a symbol across the entire workspace via LSP. Returns a WorkspaceEdit (not applied automatically). Always use dry_run=true first to preview changes. Call find_references before renaming exported symbols to understand blast radius. After applying via apply_edit, call get_diagnostics to verify no errors were introduced.

dry_run.description: If true\, return the edit without applying. Always true for this read-only tool

exclude_globs.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from rename (e.g. vendor/**\, *_gen.go)

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file

language_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. go\, typescript\, python). Optional; auto-detected from file extension

position_pattern.description: Alternative to line/column: use @@pattern@@ syntax to match text near the target position

name: rename_symbol
